archive_products.rights_basis: NOIRLab's provider-owned API authentication notebook states that anyone may retrieve public files while proprietary-file retrieval requires authorization. This adapter sends no credential and retains a product only after an exact file-metadata lookup supplies a nonblank release_date no later than the query time. Anonymous metadata about unreleased files is counted only for exclusion and is never stored. Product bytes are not downloaded.

catalog_counterparts.attribution: This research has made use of the SIMBAD database, operated at CDS, Strasbourg, France. Cite Wenger et al. (2000), A&AS, 143, 9, and the original references attached to scientific values used in publication.
catalog_counterparts.description: Public literature object inside the target cone. Its SIMBAD object type and measurements are source-native context, not proof that it is the transient, its host, or the cause of the alert.
catalog_counterparts.rights_basis: SIMBAD documents free access without registration under the ODbL license. This adapter uses the anonymous official TAP service for one bounded coordinate query, retains provider attribution and source bibcodes, and does not treat a nearby literature object as the transient, its host, or a new detection.
catalog_counterparts.source_row_exclusion: Provider-native source_row is not mirrored; normalized rights-cleared fields and the response checksum are retained.

catalog_counterparts.attribution: This research has made use of the NASA/IPAC Extragalactic Database (NED), which is operated by the Jet Propulsion Laboratory, California Institute of Technology, under contract with the National Aeronautics and Space Administration.
catalog_counterparts.description: Public NED extragalactic object inside the target cone. Position, type, redshift, and proximity are candidate evidence only; this row does not identify or adopt the transient host.
catalog_counterparts.rights_basis: The anonymous public NED TAP service documents programmatic cone searches of the NED Object Directory and requests NED acknowledgment. CTAS retains bounded source-native rows and provenance only. NED states that high-volume automated access is best-effort, so this adapter is single-threaded, starts at most one request per second, and never queries proprietary or user-account holdings.
catalog_counterparts.source_row_exclusion: Provider-native source_row is not mirrored; normalized rights-cleared fields and the response checksum are retained.
